editorial:
Imagine being the most loved person in town and then suddenly waking up to find yourself growing like a weed. That is exactly what happens to Gloria in this wild ride. You get to watch her go from a glamorous local celebrity to a giant who can barely fit through her own front door. It is a funny, heartfelt story about how she handles the shock of Late Onset Giant’s Syndrome while trying to keep her dignity. The vibe is bright and goofy, making you feel for Gloria even when she is accidentally knocking over buildings.

You will love the acting because the lead makes the struggle of being huge feel real and hilarious. The pacing is quick, though some of the middle parts drag a bit. If you want a feel-good movie that does not take itself too seriously, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: At the end, Gloria realizes that her size is actually a gift rather than a curse. After saving the town from a massive flood by acting as a human dam, she is welcomed back as a hero. She does not find a cure to shrink back down, but she learns to love her new life. The movie wraps up with Gloria designing a giant house and continuing her celebrity status as the worlds first friendly giant.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky comedies and fantasy stories about underdogs.
